subject: [NAME] - Perception models
text:
Hi [NAME], 

         I saw 
         AION is hiring a Senior Edge AI perception Engineer - thought it'd be a good time to reach out. 

         From my experience working with CTOs at vision teams, once perception systems scale, things like data indexing, auto-labeling, and QA often become major bottlenecks for model accuracy and iteration. Many teams eventually move on from open-source tools like CVAT as they grow. Given 
         AION's focus on critical infra monitoring, I imagine some of these challenges may resonate.

         Quick context: Encord helps teams like Woven (Toyota), Boston Dynamics, and Baker Hughes streamline their ML Ops pipelines across 2D and 3D data from curation --> annotation --> model eval. 

         Would you be open to a 
         20-min virtual coffee next Tue-Thu to see if this could complement your current setup? Happy to work around your schedule

subject: closing the sim-to-real loop for behavior models
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following [COMPANY]'s work on behavior modeling and simulation
- impressive stuff.

We've been working on projects w/ Nexar, Motive, and Woven (Toyota), etc.
on road-safety and AV/ADAS models, and a common challenge is closing the
loop between real-world logs, simulation outputs, and the data that's
needed to improve the next training cycle.

Encord sits in that gap as a data quality and evaluation layer - helping
teams curate, review, and track data at scale, where open-source or
in-house tooling tends to break down as volume and complexity grow.

If useful, I'd love to spend 20 min comparing notes. Would Thu or Fri work
for you?
